Medicine MBChB at University of Glasgow

What University of Glasgow asks of applicants to Medicine MBChB for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All University of Glasgow courses · Medicine field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 5 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For United States school leavers (Medicine MBChB): SAT minimum 1280 plus two APs at grade 5, including all required subjects (Chemistry, Biology and one of Maths or Physics)
  • ACT is also accepted with two APs at grade 5 including all required subjects; ACT Maths does not count as the required Maths. The page prints the ACT minimum as “1280”, which is not an ACT score, so no ACT minimum is shown here
  • SAT/ACT not required on the AP-only route: at least three APs, all at grade 5, including the required subjects

Source: the Undergraduate Medical School’s International Entry Requirements page (MBChB-specific; undated current page), reached from the Medicine course page’s link to the Medical School admissions pages. The table scopes this to United States school-leaver qualifications, with required subjects Chemistry, Biology and one of Maths or Physics. UCAT and interview still apply (see Admissions tests and Other requirements). Partly verified: the SAT route is stated, but the page misprints the ACT minimum, so the ACT route is not fully confirmed.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Undergraduate Medical School — International Entry Requirements
English language
  • IELTS Academic: 7.0 overall with no sub-test under 7.0
  • The test must be recent:
    • the required score achieved within the last two years when the complete application is considered
    • IELTS One Skill Retake accepted

The Medicine page lists IELTS only; it does not give TOEFL, PTE or other test equivalents.

Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Medicine MBChB (2027 entry)
Admissions tests
  • UCAT — required (scores are used to allocate interviews)
Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Medicine MBChB (2027 entry)
Subject prerequisites
  • Required (UK A-level): Chemistry plus one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics; GCSE English B/6 and GCSE Biology B/6 if not at A-level
  • Required (International A-level): Chemistry and Biology plus one of Physics or Mathematics
  • Required (IB): HL Chemistry and Biology; SL Physics or Mathematics at 6; SL English at 6

Matching follows the UK A-level route: Chemistry required, plus one of Biology, Physics or Mathematics (a choice the engine cannot express). International A-level and IB applicants also need Biology (shown in the items above; the IB Higher Level Biology requirement is applied in matching).

IB route differs from A-Level: IB applicants need Chemistry and Biology at Higher Level (both applied in matching), plus SL Physics or Mathematics at 6 (HL recommended) and SL English at 6. UK A-level applicants need Biology only as one option among Biology, Physics or Mathematics.

Other qualifications
  • Advanced Placement, AP-only route (United States school leavers): at least three APs, all at grade 5, including the required subjects (Chemistry, Biology and one of Maths or Physics)
  • SAT/ACT route: two APs at grade 5, including all required subjects, alongside SAT 1280 (or the ACT, see SAT/ACT)

Source: the Undergraduate Medical School’s International Entry Requirements page (MBChB-specific; undated current page), reached from the Medicine course page’s link to the Medical School admissions pages. Verified19 Oct 2026Glasgow: Undergraduate Medical School — International Entry Requirements
Other requirements
  • Interview: required (approximately 1,100 applicants are interviewed; interviews are allocated using UCAT scores)
  • Successful applicants must undertake satisfactory health and police (disclosure) checks before starting
  • Work experience in a hospital or general practice is not required, but applicants are expected to have explored the realities of a career in medicine
  • Required grades must be obtained at one sitting and at the first attempt; no resits
